_readme: Words of the SF6 Mod Suite updater (the popup that offers a new release, shown by the Native Core or the Slots Loader's plugin): the source of truth, compiled into both DLLs by tools/localisation/gen_updater_words.py. Same shape as the other modules' locale.json. The language follows the game's text language; a missing word or language: English. %s are format slots, in order. Every text is shown in the game's own message box (app.UIFlowDialog.MessageBox, Yes / No buttons), where \n is a line break, but update.downloading and update.installing: the game's ticker strip, one line. English and French written by hand; the other languages machine-translated, to be reviewed by a native speaker.

update.title.where: Title of every updater message box.

update.offer.where: The message box offering a new release, once per launch at the main menu, with three buttons: the game's Yes and No, and update.ignore. Slots: the release (1.31.0), the lines of update.line (one per package, line breaks between them), the release again. Yes installs, No asks again at the next start, the third button never asks again for that release: the last line says so and holds that button's word (the same as update.ignore).

update.ignore.where: The third button of the update.offer box (after the game's Yes and No): never ask again for this release. One short word, the same as in update.offer's last line.

update.line.where: One line of update.offer: a package and its versions, installed -> new. Slots: the package's name (SF6 Color Mod), the installed version, the new version.

update.done.where: The message box after a successful install, three buttons: the game's Yes and No, and update.show_zip. Yes closes the game and starts it again through Steam, No leaves it running (the new version applies at the next start), the third button opens Explorer on the downloaded zip (kept in reframework\data\SF6_Update_data\downloads) and the box comes back. The last line is for the players who install with Fluffy Mod Manager (a name), which keeps its own copy of each zip; it holds that button's word (the same as update.show_zip).

update.show_zip.where: The third button of the update.done box (after the game's Yes and No): opens Explorer on the downloaded zip. One short word or two, the same as in update.done's last line.

update.failed.where: The message box after a failed install (one OK button). Slot: one of the update.why_* texts. Nothing was changed; the release is offered again at the next start.

update.why_download.where: Slot of update.failed: a download did not complete.

update.why_check.where: Slot of update.failed: a downloaded zip's size or SHA-256 is not what the release says.

update.why_package.where: Slot of update.failed: a zip holds something the updater refuses (a file outside the mods' folders, a broken entry).

update.why_blocked.where: Slot of update.failed: Windows Smart App Control refuses one of the new programs. Slot: its file name (SF6_ColorModNative.dll). Smart App Control is Windows' own name: use Windows' name of the feature in that language.

update.why_files.where: Slot of update.failed: a file of the game folder could not be replaced (everything was put back).

update.downloading.where: The game's ticker strip (the short message on the left side of the screen) while the update downloads, after Yes on update.offer. Slots: the release (1.34.0), the percentage downloaded (42); %% is the percent sign. One short line.

update.installing.where: The game's ticker strip once the download is over, while the files are checked and replaced (a few seconds). Slot: the release (1.34.0). One short line.

en.update.title: SF6 Mod Suite update

SF6 Mod Suite %s is out:
%s
Install it now? The game restarts once it is done.
(Ignore: never ask again for %s.)

The update is installed. Restart the game now?

en.update.failed:
The update was not installed: %s.
Your mods are unchanged. It will be offered again at the next start.
